findings.evidenceJa: 騙し討ちなんてしない
findings.governingReading: Rin says their pact means she will not launch a surprise or treacherous attack.
findings.explanation: The English removes the deceit and surprise that define the prohibited act.

findings.governingReading: Shirou says he trusts Rin completely.
findings.explanation: The malformed English obscures the force and naturalness of his reassurance.

findings.evidenceJa: 大人しく言うコト聞きなさいよね
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to behave and do as she says if he has no questions.
findings.explanation: The English replaces obedience to her instructions with physical quietness.

findings.highlight: I don’t think I can beat Grandfather
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちではお爺さまには勝てない
findings.governingReading: Sakura says their group cannot defeat Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the inability to Sakura alone, changing the scope of her strategic assessment.

findings.highlight: I can’t ignore the shadow either
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上にあの影は放っておけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the shadow is an even greater priority than Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English turns the hierarchy into two parallel concerns.

findings.highlight: I confirm the plan with everyone
findings.evidenceJa: 異論はないな、と全員に確認する
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks everyone whether they have any objections.
findings.explanation: The English sounds as though collective agreement has already been confirmed, just before Sakura objects.

findings.evidenceJa: これは誰かの為じゃなくて
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the wish is not for someone else’s sake but is his own selfish wish.
findings.explanation: The English changes the altruism contrast into a denial of external coercion.

findings.governingReading: Shirou distinguishes inevitable danger from the costs that accompany even a winnable fight.
findings.explanation: The English collapses cost or sacrifice into a repetition of physical risk.

findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯たちを見つけても
findings.governingReading: Rin says that if they find Zouken and his side, they must not initiate an attack rashly.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the enemy group to Zouken alone.

findings.governingReading: Shirou says Rin’s willingness makes matters reassuring or gives his side someone dependable.
findings.explanation: The English loses his explicit reliance on Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: その活動は大幅に抑えた筈よ
findings.governingReading: Rin says Kirei should have greatly suppressed the Crest Worms’ activity.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the large degree and Rin’s stated epistemic qualification.

findings.highlight: unless they use a drug on you
findings.evidenceJa: 直接何かをされないかぎり
findings.governingReading: Rin says another runaway episode requires some direct intervention like Shinji’s.
findings.explanation: The English invents a drug and makes the condition needlessly specific.

findings.highlight: all the terrible things he’s done to you
findings.evidenceJa: あれだけ非道を重ねる奴
findings.governingReading: Rin points to Zouken’s accumulated inhuman atrocities as grounds for denying him human moral standing.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the charge to acts done specifically to Sakura.
